report_name: Threat Actor 'TheHatman' Sells Fortune 500 Employee Data from Azure Tenants

threat_actors.name: TheHatman
threat_actors.description: A threat actor selling large internal employee databases from numerous Fortune 500 companies, claiming the data was exfiltrated from the organizations' Microsoft Azure/Entra ID tenants.
threat_actors.goals: Sale of compromised employee data for financial gain.

attack_patterns.name: Credentials from Password Stores
attack_patterns.description: Used to acquire initial credentials, likely through widespread info-stealer malware campaigns.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Used as a likely vector to acquire initial credentials for users with privileged access to Azure environments.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts: Cloud Accounts
attack_patterns.description: Used stolen credentials to log into victims' Azure or Microsoft 365 portals for initial access.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: Accessed and exported data from services like Entra ID and SharePoint Online after gaining access to the cloud environment.

malware.name: Info-stealer malware
malware.description: Likely used in widespread campaigns to harvest credentials, which were then used to access victim Azure tenants.

tools.name: PowerShell
tools.description: Used to execute commands such as 'Get-AzureADUser -All $true | Export-Csv' to dump the entire user directory from compromised Azure tenants.

identities.name: McDonald's
identities.description: A Fortune 500 company whose internal employee database was exfiltrated from its Azure tenant and sold by TheHatman.

identities.name: Vodafone
identities.description: A Fortune 500 company whose internal employee database was exfiltrated from its Azure tenant and sold by TheHatman.

identities.name: Kyndryl
identities.description: A Fortune 500 company whose internal employee database was exfiltrated from its Azure tenant and sold by TheHatman.

infrastructure.name: TheHatman Dark Web Forum Presence
infrastructure.description: Dark web forums used by TheHatman to advertise and sell massive internal employee databases from compromised Fortune 500 companies.

indicators.name: Suspicious Entra ID Sign-in from Anonymous IP
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Entra ID Sign-in from Anonymous IP
id: 2b1c8d7e-4f5a-4b3c-8a9d-1e2f3a4b5c6d
status: experimental
description: Detects successful Entra ID sign-ins where the sign-in risk detail indicates an anonymous IP address, such as from a TOR exit node or anonymous proxy. This can be an indicator of credential compromise.
references:
  - https://www.infostealers.com/article/massive-azure-exfiltration-campaign-exposes-millions-of-enterprise-records-via-compromised-credentials-mcdonalds-vodafone-kyndryl-others/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-16
tags:
  - attack.t1078.004
  - attack.initial_access
level: high
logsource:
  product: azure
  service: signinlogs
detection:
  selection:
    ResultType: 0
    RiskDetail|contains: 'anonymousIpAddress'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects successful Entra ID logins from anonymous proxies or TOR exit nodes, as suggested in the article's hunting hints.

indicators.name: Azure AD User Directory Export via PowerShell
indicators.pattern:
title: Azure AD User Directory Export via PowerShell
id: 9e8d7c6b-5a4b-4c3d-2e1f-0a9b8c7d6e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of PowerShell to export all Azure Active Directory users to a CSV file. This is a common data collection technique after a cloud tenant compromise.
references:
  - https://www.infostealers.com/article/massive-azure-exfiltration-campaign-exposes-millions-of-enterprise-records-via-compromised-credentials-mcdonalds-vodafone-kyndryl-others/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-16
tags:
  - attack.t1530
  - attack.collection
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'Get-AzureADUser'
      - '-All'
      - '$true'
      - 'Export-Csv'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the specific PowerShell command line pattern provided in the article for dumping the Azure AD user directory.

indicators.name: Bulk Data Export from Entra ID Audit Logs
indicators.pattern:
title: Bulk Data Export from Entra ID Audit Logs
id: 8d7c6b5a-4b3c-2e1f-0a9b-8c7d6e5f9e8d
status: experimental
description: Detects bulk data export activities from Entra ID, such as exporting a user directory. This could indicate data collection by an attacker with administrative access.
references:
  - https://www.infostealers.com/article/massive-azure-exfiltration-campaign-exposes-millions-of-enterprise-records-via-compromised-credentials-mcdonalds-vodafone-kyndryl-others/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-16
tags:
  - attack.t1530
  - attack.collection
level: medium
logsource:
  product: m365
  service: audit.azuread
detection:
  selection:
    Operation: 'Export user list'
    ResultStatus: 'success'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects large-scale data export activities from Entra ID audit logs, as suggested in the hunting hints.
